_comment: LuaJIT 2.1 ROLLING, ARM64, GC64 mode. Every offset below is derived from the disassembly of the target's own lua_newstate / luaL_newstate; the instruction that establishes each field is cited in "src".

next.src: lua_State is the GCobj at the head of the chunk

glref.src: 0xa1ef764: sturh w8,[x0,#0x9] sets the mark bits of the GC header word at +8

top.src: 0xa1ef784: str xzr,[x0,#0x50] clears top; top is a 32-bit stack index

stack.src: 0xa1ef7e4: stp x8,x8,[x20,#0x20] where x8 = state+0x10 (stack base)

G.src: 0xa242e90: ldr x8,[x19,#0x10] then str x9,[x8,#0x160] (writes global_State field), so +0x10 is l_G

frealloc.src: 0xa1ef330: str x21,[x8,#0x60]! but before that 0xa1ef564: ldr x9,[x19] (allocator fn)

l_registry.src: 0xa1eefda: stp x19,x9,[x19,#0x88] seeds the registry array at G+0x88

TValue._comment: GC64: a pointer TValue is (lo, hi) and is reconstructed as hi<<32|lo, with the heap base OR'd in when bit 47 is set. Tags live in the hi word: it == 0xFFFFFFFF marks a 32-bit int, otherwise the canonical/lightuserdata marker bits.

len.src: GC64: next is 4 bytes at +0, hash at +4, len at +8

asize.src: GC64: array size lives after the 16-byte header

node.src: GC64: node array pointer (8 bytes) follows hmask

GCtab._comment: Node is (TValue key, TValue val) = 16 bytes in GC64, not 32.
